items: Finished videos on the desktop: in Export (MP4, WebM, GIF) choose Save to → The program desktop (or Both). The video appears on the desktop next to your animations and, with sync on, on your phone and other computers too

Double-click a video on the desktop to watch it; “Save to this device…” saves it as a normal file (on the phone too). On the computer the videos are real .mp4 files in Documents\Starman Does Animations

Auto masks: right-click a layer → Auto mask from layer… → pick the layer with the shapes. The layer then shows only inside those shapes (the rest is hidden) — on every frame by itself, and it follows when the shapes move or change. Right-click the auto mask to show only outside instead
Right-click a shape → Show a layer only inside these shapes: the shape goes on its own layer and becomes the auto mask for the layer you pick
Join / Cut / Overlap / Exclude now work with shapes on different layers (Shift+click them on any layer) — the result goes on the front shape’s layer (Cut: the back shape’s)
Move shapes to another layer: right-click a shape → Move to a new layer / Move to layer, or the buttons in the Shape window, or Ctrl+Shift+L for a new layer
Right-click on shapes (V or A) opens a menu: Join, Cut, Move to layer, Duplicate, Delete

Much faster big vector projects (many layers and frames): the layers you are not drawing on are kept as a ready picture, so moving, hovering and editing only redraws the current layer — about 30× less work with 30 layers
Shapes with effects (shadows, glow, inner shadow, glass, metal, light, textures, blur) are kept as ready pictures and are not recalculated on every redraw
Long vector animations now get ready for playing (a short progress bar) instead of drawing live, so playback is smooth; when very long they play a little softer, then sharp again on pause
Getting playback ready in the background is gentle now: heavy frames are made a few at a time and it pauses while the program is not in front, so the computer stays responsive
A locked mask (🔒) stays where it is: moving, turning or resizing its layer — or a linked group — no longer moves it. Unlock it to make it follow again
Fix: linked layers ⛓ now always turn, resize and move together — also when a shape was already picked before, when you grab the box handles right away, and when a linked mask is in the group
Grabbing a shape by its very middle moves it again (before it grabbed the center point). To move the center point the first time hold Alt and drag the cross; after that it can be dragged normally
Fix: a mask now turns, resizes and moves with its layer even when the mask layer is locked or painted with the brush (not only shapes)
Brush lines on vector layers can be moved, turned and resized like shapes

Link layers (masks too): right-click a layer → Link with layers… and tick the others. Linked layers get a colored ⛓. Clicking a shape on any of them picks everything on the linked layers — move, resize, turn and lean them together. Ctrl+click picks just one shape
Slow start / Slow end are much stronger now and go up to 300% — 100% is a clear, strong slow-down, 300% almost stops at the key

Shape keys ◆: “Slow start” and “Slow end” sliders (0–100%) for the motion to the next key, with a little curve picture. Shape window → Shape animation, or right-click a key → Motion to the next key → Slow start / end strength…. “Use on all keys of the layer” copies it to every key. Smooth export for FNF uses it too

Link a mask to any layer, however far: right-click the mask layer → Mask for layer… → pick the layer. The mask can stay at the top while the layer stays behind other things. The mask shows 🔗 and the layer’s name; it follows that layer’s moves, and its shapes move with the shapes they cover

Points (A): when 2 or more points are picked, a box appears around them — drag its squares to resize (Shift: evenly, Alt: from the middle), just outside the corners to turn (Shift: 15° steps), the yellow diamonds to lean. Only the picked points change; with the mirror on, their partners do the mirrored change
Combined shapes (Combine): double-click the outline with A to add a point, Delete removes points — no need to take them apart first (works with the mirror too)

FNF export (sprite sheet / FNF character), vector: Smoothness 2×–4× adds in-between pictures made from your shape keys ◆, and the fps in the character file goes up to match — smooth in the game, no jerky steps
FNF character: “Same size in game” — a bigger export Size makes the sprite sharper (the character scale is set to match), so it stays crisp when the camera zooms in

Palette from a picture (Palette ⋯ → Palette from a picture / this frame): open a picture, take this frame or a copied picture, choose how many colors (4–256) — it picks the main colors smartly and sorts them into ramps. Use as palette or add to yours
Each project now keeps its own palette: opening a project brings its palette back. Old projects keep the current palette until you change it
Mirror: a point on the mirror line keeps its curve handles straight across the line — it cannot turn and both handles stretch the same. Alt+drag a handle for a symmetric sharp corner
Mirror + points (A): double-click the outline to add a point and its mirror partner appears on the other side too
Alt+click a point (sharp ↔ smooth) or the Smooth / Sharp buttons give the partner point the same mirrored curve handles; dragging a handle bends both sides

Ctrl+Shift+D now makes a linked mirror copy: turn, move, resize or reshape the original and the copy mirrors it. Clicking the copy picks the original. “Separate copy” in Shape → Mirror still makes an independent one
Masks belong to their layer: in the layer list a mask is tucked under its layer (└) and moves with it — up/down buttons, dragging, into folders. Drag a mask onto another layer to give it to that one
Vector masks: mask shapes are picked only when the mask layer is selected — clicking on other layers no longer grabs them
Move, resize, turn or nudge a shape and the mask shapes over it come along; the selection stays just the shape
A mask also follows its layer’s own moves and motion paths

Duplicate mirrored (Ctrl+Shift+D, or the button in Shape → Mirror): copies the picked shapes to the other side of the mirror line, already flipped (4 ways / around make all the copies). Works even with the mirror off — then it flips left ↔ right
“Live copies” makes mirror copies of shapes you already drew that keep following them
Points (A): pick many at once — Shift+click or drag a box around them; drag one and they all move, Delete removes them

With the mirror on, a shape that sits on the mirror line stays symmetric: move a point or bend a curve on one side and its partner on the other side does the same (cyan rings show the partners); points on the line stay on it
Lean (skew): drag the yellow diamonds next to the sides of the selection. Shift: steps of 15°, Alt: around the center point
Center point: drag the round cross in the selection to choose what turning (and Alt-resizing) goes around; it moves with the shapes. Double-click it to put it back in the middle

Snapping for every vector tool: rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, line, pen, brush ends, spiral, moving, resizing, turning (sticks to 45°), points and the mirror handle. Sticks to centers, edges, points and outlines of shapes, the camera middle/edges/corners and the mirror line, with pink guide lines
Key ; (Ж) or the ⌖ button turns snapping on and off; Ctrl still places freely for a moment

Vector mirror ⇋ (Shift+M): left ↔ right, top ↕ bottom, 4 ways or around like a kaleidoscope (2–24 copies). New shapes get copies that follow the original when you move, reshape or recolor it. Drag the cyan handle to move the mirror — the copies move with it. “Unlink copies” makes them normal shapes
Video export: new quality “Best (for posting)” — 20 Mbit/s, so social networks have a clean picture to start from

Scale drawings on all frames at once (Shift+T, the Animation window, or right-click a layer): any size %, width and height separately, around the middle of the drawings, the feet, the canvas, the camera or the corner; this layer or all layers; all, selected or one frame. You see it while you change it, the canvas stays the same size

Uses much less memory: ready playback pictures have a smaller limit that depends on the computer and are freed as soon as they are out of date, onion ghosts keep only the frames around you, smoothed (Render) pictures are kept only for the frame on screen, big effect pictures are given back
Vector effects: inner shadow, inner glow and the edge bevel are drawn a new way — no more stray stripes, and a sharp (softness 0) inner shadow is no longer cut off

Palette packs: Palette ⋯ → Palette packs — 35 ready palettes from 2 to 256 colors: classic (PICO-8, Game Boy, CGA, web safe…), big ramps (up to 256), greys, skin tones, hair, eyes, forest, ocean, sky, desert, ice, fire, autumn, spring, pastel, neon, candy, night city, spooky, muted, metals, wood & stone
Use replaces your palette, + Add adds the new colors to it; Ctrl+Z brings the old palette back
Vector gradients: as many colors as you like (click the gradient bar to add one, drag the marks to move, Remove, ⇄ to turn it around)
New gradient kinds: Rings, Sweep (around the center) and Stripes, plus Straight and Round
Gradient center, size and number of repeats; the Gradient tool (Shift+G) sets the center and size for round ones by dragging
Folders that stay only on this device: right-click a folder → “Only on this device (no cloud sync)”, or New → “Folder only on this device”. They get a ⌂ mark and cloud sync never sends or fills them
MP4 export rewritten: real H.264 MP4 files made frame by frame (exact timing, plays and seeks everywhere, faster than real time), sound included
Playback follows the clock: no more slowing down, a late frame is skipped instead of dragging
Playback is prepared in the background while you rest, so Play starts at once; the timeline is barely touched while playing
Onion skin: ghost frames are kept ready, stepping through frames is much quicker
Settings → Speed: Fast mode for weak laptops (fewer screen pixels on high-DPI screens), Auto picks it for weak computers
Duplicate several frames at once: select them (Shift + click on the frame numbers or cels) and press D or the duplicate button — the copies go right after them and stay selected
Timeline: Backspace empties the current cel; with cels selected (Shift + click) Backspace or Delete empties all of them; with whole frames selected it removes the frames. Ctrl+Z brings them back
Vector art stays sharp while playing (it was prepared at camera size and looked pixelated when zoomed in)
Vector: shape animation ◆ — make a key on a later frame (Shift+K), change the shapes there, the frames in between move by themselves (every point follows), with easing
Vector: clicking a shape takes you to its layer; Ctrl+A selects shapes on all layers, the selection box works across layers
Vector effects: Light & 3D with a ball to place the sun (highlight, shade, sun glint, edge bevel), inner shadow, inner glow, materials: glass, metal, chrome, gold, plastic, satin
Vector tools: Liquify (W: push, twirl, pinch, puff up), Scissors (C), Paint bucket (G), Gradient by dragging (Shift+G), Spiral (Shift+S)
Vector: polygon is now Y (N adds a frame again), Alt + arrows move shapes (arrows change frames)
Joined / cut shapes: the outline now follows the real edge, no more notches where the shapes meet
Vector brush (B): draw freely, the line becomes points you can move with A; smooth curves or sharp zigzag, smoothness setting
Points: make one point or the whole shape smooth or sharp, double-click a line (A) to add a point
Combine shapes: Join, Cut out (the top shape cuts itself out), Overlap, Hole (the overlap becomes empty), Take apart
Snapping to the points and the outlines of other shapes
Stroke width stays the same when scaling (can be switched off), stroke inside / outside, custom dashes, arrows and dots on line ends, round gradients
Position and size fields (X, Y, W, H, turn)
Effects: shadow, glow, blur, blend modes, textures (dots, stripes, hatching, grain…) or your own picture
Brush, Animation, Render and Export settings are now separate windows: F5, F6, F7, F8 (or the ☰ button). Move them anywhere, they remember their place. The canvas gets the space
Vector art: Selection (V) — move, scale, turn, Alt-drag copies; Direct selection (A) — edit points and curves; Pen (P); Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Line; Eyedropper
Vector art: fill and stroke colors (X switches, Shift+X swaps), gradient fill, dashed / dotted strokes, ends and corners, round corners
Vector art: arrange (Ctrl+[ ]), align and spread evenly, flip, turn 90°, copy / paste / duplicate, smart guides that stick to other shapes and the camera
Vector art has its own simple menu: only Rectangle and Circle
Shapes are real vector shapes: fill with the current color, outline with its own color and width, round corners, opacity
The Brush tab becomes the Shape tab in vector files; old vector drawings still show as before
Phone: no black frames around the canvas while zooming out or moving
Phone: pinch zoom in pixel art no longer jumps 100% → 200%: it stays exactly where you leave it
Phone: zoom and moving the canvas follow your fingers instantly (the picture is redrawn when you stop)
Phone: ✋ Hand button — move around the canvas with one finger, without zooming or drawing
Phone: all tools fit on the screen (two rows), bigger buttons, windows no longer go off the screen
Phone: pinch zoom is smooth (pixel art snaps to a whole zoom when you let go)
Phone: onion skins no longer lag behind when you move the canvas with two fingers
Phone: big animations play without filling the memory (no more crashes when playing)
Very big files are skipped by cloud sync instead of crashing it
Phone: .sdt / .sdp / .sdv / .sdz and Aseprite files can be picked for import again
Files without a proper name are recognised by what is inside
“Open with Starman Does Animations”: double-click .sdt / .sdp / .sdv / .sdz files in Explorer, and open .aseprite files with it (the Android app too)
Computer updates now also update the program part, not only the page
Cloud sync: the same animations on your computer and phone (Start → Cloud sync). Files are kept in your own private GitHub storage
Syncs by itself after saving, every few minutes and when the app opens; the ☁ button on the taskbar shows the state
If one file was changed on two devices, both versions are kept
Phone and tablet layout: full-screen canvas, tools at the bottom, palette, settings and timeline slide up
Touch: two fingers zoom and move the canvas, two-finger tap = undo, three-finger tap = redo
Install on Android as an app (from the web page, or the APK)
This “What’s new” window, and “Check for updates” in the Start menu
Big animations no longer hit the 5 MB browser limit (files are kept in IndexedDB)
Sprite layers: animated clips with their own tab, ◆ keys choose idle / run / jump…
Hide a sprite on some frames, remove keys on selected frames
◆ motion keys for any layer with the Move tool (“Whole layer”)
Hue / Saturation window (Ctrl+U) like Aseprite
More export formats: Animated PNG, MP4, sheet + JSON, WebP / JPEG
.sdz packages to move animations to another computer
Free transform: scale, turn, slant (Ctrl), one corner (Alt)
Templates gallery with tags and layer colors
Camera zoom and turn while playing
